website.note: Corporate clinical-data page; lists commercial Aquablation/HYDROS/AquaBeam Robotic Systems and historical WATER family studies. No drug pipeline.

ctgov.note: Sponsor query returned 0 P1/P2/P3 hits because all PROCEPT-sponsored studies are device studies coded Phase=NA. Confirmed via direct ctgov.gov API query that PROCEPT sponsors NCT06051942 (PRCT001), NCT06054867 (PRCT002), NCT06651632 (WATER IV PCa), NCT04658056 (UK PMS), NCT04308070, NCT03125889 — all Phase=NA device trials.

approved_devices.name: AquaBeam Robotic System
approved_devices.indication: Surgical resective treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH); 510(k)/De Novo cleared in the US for Aquablation therapy

approved_devices.name: HYDROS Robotic System
approved_devices.indication: Next-generation Aquablation therapy platform for BPH (prostates 20-150 mL); FDA-cleared

active_device_clinical_studies.design: Global, prospective, post-market, multi-center safety study of Aquablation therapy in patients with BPH and localized prostate cancer; n=125; US/HK/Lebanon/Canada/Portugal
IDE (G230155), prospective, post-market, multi-center study of Aquablation therapy in patients with localized prostate cancer; enrollment complete across 3 US centers (n=22)
active_device_clinical_studies.regulatory_classification: IDE (investigational use of cleared device for new indication)

active_device_clinical_studies.design: Global multi-center prospective randomized 3:1 trial of Aquablation therapy vs radical prostatectomy in Grade Group 1-3 localized prostate cancer; planned n up to 280 at up to 50 centers; 10-year follow-up
active_device_clinical_studies.regulatory_classification: Pivotal device study for new indication

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Medtech/surgical-robotics company. PROCEPT develops the AquaBeam and HYDROS Robotic Systems delivering Aquablation therapy for BPH; the products are FDA-cleared devices (not drugs), so no Phase 1/2/3 drug pipeline exists. Active company-sponsored device studies (PRCT001, PRCT002, WATER IV PCa) are coded Phase=NA on ClinicalTrials.gov and are recorded under active_device_clinical_studies.
